label: Copper as Share of Total Exports
delta: LME hit a new all-time record of US$6.736/lb on Aug 17, 2026 (+40% YoY), extending the Aug 6 record of US$6.557/lb; rally now driven by AI-infrastructure demand and expected cathode tariffs on top of DR Congo's copper/cobalt export ban; Dipres projects a record US$8.04B in mining payments to the Treasury in 2026. Copper closed Sep 8–9 at US$14,737/tonne (~US$6.68/lb), its second-highest close on record, as US tariff fears and Chile/Peru supply constraints (Chilean output down 9.4% YoY in July after storm damage) met sustained Chinese demand. COCHILCO's weekly report for Sep 21–25 confirmed copper held at US$6.68/lb (+1.45% on the week), with the 2026 annual average now 40.57% above the same period in 2025, as tight near-term availability in China and London offset dollar strength and US rate-hike expectations

source: Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
delta: Approval kept sliding past the six-month mark: Criteria put Kast at 29%/59% disapproval on Sep 20 (from 30% on Sep 6), then Data Influye recorded a term-low 25%/62% disapproval on Sep 23. A Chilean tribunal sentenced 18 members of the radical Resistencia Mapuche Lafkenche to combined 1,000+ years over a 2022 mill arson in Contulmo (Sep 21). Kast made his UN General Assembly debut Sep 22 ('Chile está de vuelta'), meeting Canada's PM Carney on the sidelines, then met Venezuela's Delcy Rodríguez in New York Sep 24 over migration and consular ties. Chile's formal adhesion to the US-backed Escudo de las Américas security initiative (announced ~Sep 22–23) drew PS criticism and, on Sep 25, an unprecedented joint declaration from former presidents Bachelet and Boric asking Kast to reconsider — the first time since 1990 two ex-presidents have jointly challenged a sitting government's foreign policy; ruling-coalition party leaders rebuked the pair as 'unfortunate and petty' on Sep 26
